post.description: [risk: write] Register an RSA SSH public key for a JumpServer user so they can log in to koko (port 2222) without a password. Only ssh-rsa is accepted, because koko rejects ed25519 even though the bastion accepts it silently. Keys live in a separate SSHKey table, NOT in the user's public_key field: writing that field answers 200 and reports can_public_key_auth=true while storing nothing, and the key is then rejected at login. This tool writes to the table that actually works and verifies the key landed on the requested user. the API has no cross-user endpoint for this (v4 and v5 alike): the key is registered as the account that owns the credential, so use it for the user this MCP acts as.（需确认：set confirm=true to write the key to the bastion）
